annotations.title: Join a tournament or hidden-list game

description: Enters the signed-in player in a tournament by its token, as its invite link does, or in a hidden-list game of a group they belong to. A tournament whose organizer approves each player answers pending until they let you in. Closed once lists are revealed or the roster deadline passes. Requires mcp:write.

eventToken.description: eventToken from list_my_events; only an old link needs it.

token.description: The tournament or hidden-list game token, from list_my_events or its invite link.
